screenshots.result: No clipping, overlap or inaccessible visible buttons in inspected representative images. Automated bounds covered confirmation, ready and cancelled states across all 12 combinations.

acceptance.evidence: Three distinct school/work/daily starts plus a separate custom goal entry, four-language text input; voice input visibly unavailable.
Explicit who/where/goal/worry confirmation, editable one field at a time; empty goal asks one necessary question and leaves other unknowns intact.
Changing goal updates actual step and practice-prompt list items; new confirmation creates an immutable revision while old content remains selectable.

Unlisted raw goals stay intact in clearly disclosed generic communication templates; focus changes the actual interaction instructions. Actual arbitrary-task generation remains untested and belongs to T14.
No real names, school/employer identifiers or medical records required; seed scenes are illustrative and edited details become user-provided.
Goal and chosen support are part of each version, one focus at a time; no required English answer or fixed correct sentence. Dynamic AI conversation remains untested.
Ordered dialogue/media/check demo states, explicit failure/cancel controls, no fabricated countdown; real_media_ready always false.
Reload restores goal, version, form buffer and preparation; only the failed part retries, preserving successful artifacts and rejecting old attempt/version events.

review_fixes: Persisted unsubmitted description and editing buffers across language unmount and refresh without confirming or mutating saved versions.
Strict string enumeration checks reject malformed array-valued fields and preserve old storage bytes on read failure.
User edits to any substantive seed field clear seed provenance rather than claiming the new facts came from the specification.
Localize generic instruction rendering using the current auxiliary language while keeping user text and stored historical versions untouched.
